note: Which sentences of the reference note bear on each target. A sentence is identified by a phrase that occurs in exactly one sentence of the prepared note, so this file survives the note being re-prepared. 'gold' is the main source, in the acute primary angle closure material (the sections 'Acute primary angle closure' and 'Managing an acute attack', plus the definition of the condition). 'alsoSupports' is other text in that material that backs the point. 'offSection' is text elsewhere in the note that backs the point: correct, but not where the case author says to cite from. 'distractor' is text that shares the words but is about something else, and does not back the point. The revision checks marked 'all_support' leave out every passage listed under gold, alsoSupports and offSection for kp1, kp2, kp3 and kp5 and expect 'no support'; those four lists are meant to be complete. The other targets list the main supporting text, not every sentence: a few table cells (for example the single word 'Acetazolamide') have no phrase of their own to be identified by.
